Canada

Across the Northern Rockies

THE RECORD SO FAR

What the sources establish.

Regional launch planning / historical research open

The Western Canada approach is a planning decision. British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba are discussion regions, not confirmed territories. Selection of a lead province remains deferred. Canadian dealer histories and dated market-entry records still need verification.

Chapter names and research themes come from the original legacy website. The research themes below identify material to gather; they do not establish that these records or relationships already exist.
